propositions: The tickets branch is 1.04 GiB with 92% devoted to reconciler .bridge_state cache bookkeeping fields that are not read in src, making git delta compression inefficient.
Deleting baseline_advanced_at field and moving last_get_pass bookkeeping to separate files reduces marginal packed cost per version from 12.79 KB to approximately 1.74 KB (7.4x improvement).
The reconciler runs on ephemeral runners so .bridge_state must remain committed in git; the solution makes the cache cheap via content and churn reduction rather than relocating it.
A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/filter/fast-import reduces existing repository size from 1.17 GB to 98 MB (8.4%) while preserving all commits and tree identity.
Mixed-version compatibility and rollback require write-both/read-max protocol during rollout, epoch guards at union merge sites, and operator-quiesced fail-closed recovery using off-repo bundles.
